before: BODY / FIT accepted source-distinct sensor bundles, and a Health Connect adapter contract existed.
No Android/Wear implementation existed in the repository.
The next Health Connect dependency was partly architectural rather than purely device-bound.
intervention: Searched the repository for existing Android/Wear/Health Connect donors; none were found.
Implemented a minimal Android source bridge under /bridge/health-connect-reader/.
Restricted declared Health Connect permissions to READ_SLEEP + READ_HEART_RATE.
Excluded INTERNET, Health Connect write, background-health and historical-read permissions.
Read only on explicit foreground action over a 36-hour window.
Mapped SleepSessionRecord and HeartRateRecord into existing 0xxx0/body-sensor-observation/v0.1 records and 0xxx0/body-sensor-bundle/v0.1.
Preserved source app, device, recording method, Health Connect record id and source timestamps.
Kept heart-rate source samples unaveraged and declared a 5000-newest-sample cap.
Added path-scoped Android assemble / least-privilege / APK existence CI.
after: The Health Connect gap is no longer an implementation/specification gap.
A build-verified read-only bridge exists and targets BODY / FIT's current sensor envelope.
WAITING can now name one exact physical/device proof instead of an architectural task.
non_claims: No real phone install has been observed.
No Health Connect permission UI has been exercised on the user's device.
No Samsung Health or Galaxy Watch source record has been observed by this bridge.
No personal health data was produced or committed.
A build-verified debug APK is not a promoted production health application.
residue: Real-device install + Sleep/Heart rate grant + one 36-hour export remains required.
One exported bundle must import into BODY / FIT with source/device/timestamp/missingness semantics intact.
Automatic local relay remains deliberately unimplemented until the manual proof shows enough value.
next: Install/test one real bundle; RETURN PASS / FAIL / AMBIGUOUS. Do not broaden permissions or automate transport before that proof.
